messages.en: Have you been following the doctor's advice?
Yeah, I've been doing what the doctor said. It doesn't hurt as much now.
I closed the kitchen window earlier. The rain was getting in.
Thanks! I'll wipe up the floor there in a bit, okay?
I'm sorry. I don't want to hurt your feelings.
I understand. Just say it nicely next time, okay?

collocations.en: hurt someone's feelings; make someone angry

messages.en: I know he was only joking, but his comment on WhatsApp really hurt.
Try talking it through with him calmly. Maybe he doesn't realise you're upset.
